resourceTitle: Local Video File Only, No Embed Fallback
shortDescription: videoFile is populated, embedUrl is blank. Confirms the video renders correctly with no fallback link present.
body: This item has a local video asset and nothing else in the media block.
author: Morgan Vickery

shortDescription: embedUrl points to YouTube, videoFile is blank. Confirms the Watch Video button path renders.
body: Standard YouTube embed link, no local video asset.
author: Lisa Sieg

shortDescription: embedUrl points to Vimeo instead of YouTube — confirms the button treats embedUrl as a generic link rather than assuming a YouTube URL shape.
body: Vimeo-hosted recording, linked rather than embedded inline.
author: Jennifer Hall

resourceTitle: Embed URL That Is Not Actually a Video
shortDescription: embedUrl is a plain webpage (not a video host) and a second variant with no scheme at all — tests that the widget doesn't assume the URL is playable.
body: The widget builds a plain anchor tag around embedUrl regardless of what it points to — this checks that a non-video destination still degrades gracefully instead of erroring.
author: Heather Hammond

author: Kristina Maricle

resourceTitle: Multiple formatType Categories On One Item
shortDescription: formatType has three categories assigned instead of one — confirms whether the widget's tag row (and the listing widget's radio filter) assumes a single value.
body: If formatType is meant to be single-select in the content type, this item deliberately violates that to see what breaks.
author: Morgan Vickery

resourceTitle: Missing reviewedBy — QC Gate Direct-URL Test
shortDescription: reviewedBy is blank. Per the listing widget's QC gate this should NOT appear in the listing, but should still load fine at its direct detail URL — confirms the detail widget itself does not also gate on reviewedBy.
body: Load this item by its direct URL, not by clicking through the listing — it should not appear there.
author: Heather Hammond

shortDescription: relatedInstructionalResources includes this item's own urlTitle — checks for an infinite-feeling loop or a card linking to the page you're already on.
body: Check the Related Resources section below — one of the cards should point right back to this same page.
author: Lisa Sieg

shortDescription: 8 related resources on a 2-column grid — well past a single row, to check spacing, alignment, and whether the widget caps or paginates the list.
body: Scroll to Related Resources below and count the cards — there should be eight.
author: Kristina Maricle

resourceTitle: Related Resource Points to a QC-Gated Item
shortDescription: relatedInstructionalResources links to "Missing reviewedBy" (stress-missing-reviewedby), an item that would be excluded from the listing — confirms whether a related-resource card renders fine even when its target fails the listing's QC gate.
body: The one related card below points at an unreviewed item that would never show up in the main listing.
author: Jennifer Hall
